scope: Offline adversarial inputs, not captures or proof of parser, transport or CA acceptance

late-exact.purpose: Move the exact designation to page three; preserve three coherent pages

repeated-reference.purpose: Same proven product reference occurs twice with separate page occurrences

two-exact-identities.purpose: Second exact designation has distinct published SKU and URL key; not a conflicting shared identity

conflicting-reference.purpose: Same SKU with contradictory detail link cannot prove deduplication or two valid identities

missing-identifier.purpose: Missing URL key prevents linking candidate to detail

late-mismatch.purpose: After search and detail evidence, later same-meaning form SKU contradicts selected identity

graphql-errors-data.purpose: HTTP 200 and candidate data cannot hide GraphQL errors

graphql-recovered.purpose: Experimental retry sequence only, not approval of nonzero production retries

http-forbidden.purpose: Primary HTTP 403 is not absence and cannot trigger fallback

http-rate-limit.purpose: Primary HTTP 429 is not an exhaustive negative

http-server-error.purpose: Primary HTTP 500 is not an exhaustive negative

invalid-json.purpose: Truncated JSON keeps its lineage but cannot prove identity

unknown-schema.purpose: A similar field name is not a supported catalog schema

page-omitted.purpose: An exact candidate does not excuse missing page two

page-repeated.purpose: Repeated page one must not close a three-page search

totals-drift.purpose: Totals change after an exact candidate was seen

page-type.purpose: A numeric string is not an integer page index

asset-loop.purpose: The same metadata offset is returned twice while more is declared

asset-pending.purpose: Captured metadata does not close the required collection when hasMore is true

missing-null-empty-types.purpose: Ordered duplicate technical keys preserve missing, null, empty and JSON value types

documents-co-populated.purpose: Invented populated downloads marker is unsupported, not authentic positive document support

documents-ap-populated.purpose: Invented AP populated downloads cannot be certified from empty captures

unknown-main.purpose: Empty selectors in an unknown template are not proof of absence

applications-distinct-queries.purpose: Same path, repeated parameters and different identity must survive logical application extraction

external-entities.purpose: Inert adversarial XML/HTML bytes; never resolve file or network entities

steps.body: <!DOCTYPE html [<!ENTITY local SYSTEM 'file:///SYNTHETIC-not-a-real-file'><!ENTITY remote SYSTEM 'https://example.invalid/SYNTHETIC-entity'>]><html><body>&local;&remote;<script>throw 'SYNTHETIC do not execute';</script></body></html>

dangerous-urls.purpose: Destination policy inputs only; none is navigated or certified by this corpus

unresolved-resource.purpose: Original template, noninteger position and boolean role remain raw; do not fabricate URL or download

finite-volume.purpose: Small finite seed to cross explicit test-only limits during future supervised processing; no production limit or RSS claim
